title: The Longest One
goal: Give longest a signature the borrow checker accepts.
hints: The returned reference could be a OR b - so its lifetime must be tied to both inputs.
Declare one lifetime, apply it to both parameters and the return.
explanation: The compiler cannot elide the output lifetime when there are two borrowed inputs: it needs you to say that the returned &str lives as long as BOTH a and b. `fn longest<'a>(a: &'a str, b: &'a str) -> &'a str` encodes exactly that - 'a becomes the shorter of the two input lifetimes. Returning String would compile away the problem, but at the cost of allocating; the call site passes borrows, so the types would no longer match.
